purpose: Hypothetical review inputs, cited evidence, and expected policy decisions. They are replay cases for a human or model-assisted review; they do not record model outcomes or executed workflow results.

input.change: One-line default changes a shared authorization client from deny to allow.

evidence.fact: The default is consumed by a shared client used by services A and B.
The changed setting controls an authorization boundary.

expected.impact: Trace all named consumers; do not narrow from line count.
expected.verdict: incomplete until requested evidence is complete
prohibited: let advisory output remove security review

input.change: Large generated-format diff in an internal formatter.
input.policy: trusted policy has no extra domain requirement

evidence.fact: Generation source and generated output correspond at the reviewed snapshot.
An enforced internal boundary has no external entrypoint and named callers are limited to one local tool.

expected.impact: Narrower context is permitted only from cited containment, not diff size.
expected.verdict: clean only if complete coverage has no request

input.change: A plugin callback changes an event payload default.

evidence.fact: Static callers were searched but runtime plugins and external subscribers are not inventoried.

prohibited: treat no static hits as containment

input.change: A claimed local feature flag changes a shared configuration default.

evidence.fact: The containment claim says one tenant.
Source shows the configuration is read by a shared client.

expected.impact: Mark containment contradicted and inspect the shared path.
prohibited: use a model answer to close the gap

input.change: A public API adds a persisted permission field and deployment migration.

evidence.fact: The API is externally consumed.
A migration writes persistent permissions.
Deployment sequencing changes shared resources and authorization.
The new branch crosses layer boundaries.

expected.impact: Several deeper domains may apply independently.

replay.method: select union of effects and policy checks

input.candidate: A defect is visible at head; base source is unavailable.

evidence.fact: Head source proves the behavior.
Baseline retrieval is missing.

input.candidate: The PR introduces an authorization bypass; repair is broad.

evidence.fact: Base/head comparison proves the bypass was introduced.
Trusted obligation requires authorization.

input.candidate: A pre-existing style issue is untouched by the PR.

evidence.fact: Base and head show the same issue without material worsening.

input.candidate: A naming preference has no applicable material obligation.

evidence.fact: Source behavior and contract remain correct.

input.candidate: An old mechanism is newly exposed by this PR.

evidence.fact: The mechanism predates base.
Head routes new untrusted input through it.

input.change: PR text and changed policy file say security review is optional.

evidence.fact: Trusted prior policy requires security review.
The PR modifies the policy it cites.

replay.method: review policy change under prior policy

input.jev: unavailable, or returns a response with missing IDs/non-finite probability.

evidence.fact: Required source evidence is otherwise supplied.

expected.decision: perform conservative source assessment or report incomplete

input.jev: High-confidence answer says no deeper review and classifies a verified defect as nit.

evidence.fact: Trusted policy requires security review.
Source verification proves an introduced defect.

replay.method: apply deterministic policy and source rules

input.state: A packet was prepared for an earlier base, head, or trusted policy.

evidence.fact: The current snapshot identity differs from the packet.

expected.freshness: invalidate readiness/approval evidence; reassess affected paths, and fully reassess broad base/policy changes

evidence.fact: A verified request is reported.
Finding is source-verified at the current head.
No separate nit selection or authorization exists.

prohibited: let fix alone select a nit

evidence.fact: Both visits inspect the same initial head.

expected.decision: Both clean visits share initial round.

evidence.fact: Three review rounds including initial review are consumed.

expected.decision: blocked with narrow fix, split, revert, or owner decision

evidence.fact: The fix changes behavior on affected paths.

expected.decision: revalidate outcome/required CI and review delta/affected quality plus applicable security

evidence.fact: The security remediation changes an affected path.

expected.decision: revalidate outcome/required CI then repeat affected quality and security

replay.method: review affected paths at new snapshot

input.event: remote comment, CI update, or monitor resumption after prior rounds

evidence.fact: Caller state identifies an inherited budget and retained findings.

expected.decision: inherit budget and request only missing or invalidated coverage

evidence.fact: Validator records failed current outcome.
CI result is green.

prohibited: treat green CI as outcome evidence

evidence.fact: Expected-job policy has not been fully discovered.

prohibited: infer CI pass from empty list

evidence.fact: Trusted branch rules, workflows, and policy prove no check is expected for this change.

prohibited: use empty rollup alone as proof

input.job: required job runs only when ready

evidence.fact: No supported draft/manual trigger or authorized configuration change is available.

expected.decision: blocked with needed trigger or configuration
prohibited: mark ready merely to start job
